tasks.label: Check local X1 configuration
tasks.command: set -o pipefail && env -u NIXPKGS_ALLOW_UNFREE NIX_BUILD_HOST=x1-carbon-8th make check-local 2>&1 | tee .vscode/check-local.log

tasks.label: Build local X1 configuration
tasks.command: set -o pipefail && env -u NIXPKGS_ALLOW_UNFREE NIX_BUILD_HOST=x1-carbon-8th nix-build '<nixpkgs/nixos>' -A system -I nixos-config="$PWD/configuration.nix" --no-out-link 2>&1 | tee .vscode/build-local.log
